dishes.name: Wurstebrei
dishes.desc: Soft, spiced pork and groats sausage, fried and eaten with bread or boiled with sauerkraut. A winter staple of East Westphalian kitchens.

dishes.name: Westphalian Stuten
dishes.desc: Sweet, soft raisin bread, sliced and eaten with butter or the local cured ham. A traditional East Westphalian bakery loaf.

dishes.name: Broad beans with bacon
dishes.desc: Broad beans stewed with smoked bacon and savory herbs, served with boiled potatoes. A summer farmhouse dish across Westphalia and Lippe.

dishes.name: Schmoräppelkes
dishes.desc: Apples stewed in a pan with sugar, butter and cinnamon, sometimes with pumpernickel crumbs. A traditional Westphalian dessert.
